reviews.text: Courteous. Affectionate. Competent.

The best parrot vet ever
Dr. Nappi has cared for all my lovebirds for years and has extraordinary expertise and compassion.

We were cared for and guided with such care and attention by Dr. Vitolo.
We had no idea what owning a rabbit entailed, and thanks to his incredible professionalism and dedication, we spent eight wonderful years knowing we were in excellent hands.
Unfortunately, a few months ago, it was time for Kairy to retire, but thanks to this clinic, we know we were able to give her the best life she could.

One of my pet rats was examined by Dr. Nappi. I'm extremely satisfied with the experience. Unfortunately, it's not easy for us "rat owners" to find such professional vets! Danno and I are very happy! Thank you!
Competent and available.

My cat, Acqua, was treated by Dr. Alessandra Mani. I wanted to thank the doctor for her professionalism and the gentle, kind treatment she gave both to my cat and to us owners. My questions were always answered. Acqua is doing better thanks to the care the doctor gave her in her office. 👍👏 The cost of visits, tests, including histology, and treatment was fair. I was very pleased.
Good professional empaths
Very nice and kind doctors. Very affectionate with animals. Comfortable and clean environment, with excellent equipment.

I'm extremely happy to have found this clinic, recommended by the nutritionist who treats my dogs.
The staff is very kind and friendly. We're treated by Dr. Penna, who is extremely kind, courteous, and knowledgeable. She's honest in her assessments, no matter what.
My dog ​​was lucky enough to have her spayed with her, which went very well. My little star was already in great shape that afternoon, eating and playing. The next morning (less than 24 hours after the procedure), she went for a walk and couldn't go home again!
Thank you so much ♥️
Very professional, competent and welcoming.
Always very helpful! Kind and truly competent doctors! For both "classic" and exotic pets.
Very good and professional service!
Trained and competent staff!
I wanted to thank Dr. Barbieri for her professionalism, humanity, and courtesy—simply top!

Dr. Alessandra was fantastic.
Sweet and precise, a very thorough first visit to my Zeus. She provided me with all the answers I was looking for in a very professional manner.
The price was also fair, which is another thing you shouldn't expect.
Highly recommended!
I brought my Rainbow Lorikeet Lodovico and they visited and cared for him with care
Professionalism and competence

We can only be grateful for having met extraordinary doctors over the years who have always reassured us, explained, guided us, and listened to us for all the dogs and cats that have been part of our family over the years.
Today we arrived without an appointment with our little Leo (a 6-month-old Maltipoo), who had been acting very strangely for a few hours and had spasms that scared us.
We were greeted with humanity, kindness, and the usual professionalism that distinguishes every doctor at the clinic. We returned home feeling more at peace, knowing that our puppy was examined and pampered by someone who loves animals unconditionally, just like us.
I've known this clinic for years and continue to think that having it just minutes from home is an incredible blessing. Thank you, thank you again.
I've been going there for 25 years and I wouldn't go anywhere else.
Attentive, precise, always kind and available for advice, prices in line with the market
Dr. Valentina Penna is attentive, scrupulous, and very professional.

We must thank the entire clinic staff, but especially Dr. Barbieri. She was extremely knowledgeable, empathetic, professional, and very clear in explaining oncology scenarios and treatments. She enabled us to make a comprehensive assessment of the situation, leaving nothing out. Despite an invasive and complex operation, our dog recovered perfectly and without any after-effects. She has now become our primary veterinarian. What more can I say, other than thank you?

AWFUL EXPERIENCE
I called to inquire about cat euthanasia. The doctor was very kind and offered me a solution, giving me a contact number to do it at home, since that's not a service they offer.
Unfortunately, the number didn't exist. I called the doctor back, but he was VERY rude, dismissing me, telling me to contact my vet, and even annoyed.
Given that I'm a customer of theirs (not a regular one),
MANNERS, GENTLEMEN, MANNERS!!!
I think the best veterinary clinic for exotic animals in Milan

I start calling before 11am, and the answering machine is always there. They deign to answer shortly before 2pm. I explain that I have a hamster in critical condition, with labored breathing and tremors. They tell me they have ultrasounds to do, which are definitely more lucrative than a visit, and the first possible appointment will therefore be in 4 days.... Congratulations for your availability, empathy, and honesty, first and last time!!!
Exotic animal vet: very sweet and competent🥰 …
I had a great time, I love animals in general. Well done, a great team.

I chose this place for my two rabbits about 3 years . because I met few doctors reallly nice and caring . And they always charge price very acceptable. Today I went there again becasue of the trust I didn’t ask the price before . Then the doctor Valentina penna. To give two rabbits vaccines cost 200 euros … It’s obviously very expensive … she told me this price already without the visiting cost,otherwise would be more . After visit I called other few veterinary around , everyone cheaper than this price, to do vaccine always include visit check. Very disappointed. I can feel other doctor in this place love animals . But She is making money as target … very bad experience. Unlucky that this time I have been changed doctor ….
Prepared and competent
Wonderful staff

We're so happy we found this clinic! The staff was exceptional in every way: professional, attentive, and above all, very human. They welcomed us with kindness and cared for our hamsters, Nachos and Guacamole, with a sensitivity that truly touched us. It's rare to find people so empathetic and competent at the same time. Highly recommended!
Precise, empathetic, professional.

Excellent experience
I highly recommend

I absolutely recommend the clinic. They cared for us attentively and carefully with two elderly cats, one of whom they accompanied to her final resting place in a very humane manner, for which I am very grateful. I will definitely be back.
Very kind and very professional as well as competent veterinarians
Excellent facility. Doctor very good for guinea pigs and rabbits.

I really wanted to leave a review. My cat developed a serious tumor in August and is being monitored at the clinic. Knowing our emergency, the practice welcomed us right away, even though we weren't regulars. The staff is very competent and leaves nothing to chance! They've always been kind, caring, and truly helpful. Dr. Barbieri in particular has been incredibly helpful and is still following us step by step through this treatment. I highly recommend this clinic!
Competent, kind, and helpful exotic animal veterinarians.
Professional and knowledgeable. Recommended.
Excellent service with my cat. Very kind and caring doctor.
Fantastic!! Competent and kind. We'll be back.
Excellent care, 100% professional, my dog ​​recovered happily, with the assistance of this veterinary clinic
Skills and courtesy.
Very kind and professional...

Excellent clinic, all the staff are well-trained and competent, they listen and give excellent advice.
Truly warm-hearted people, even in difficult times.
Recommended A++

I'm very happy to come here with my cat. She needs vaccinations and spaying. Even though my Italian isn't good, the doctor still warmly welcomed me and my cat and gave me a large bag of cat food. This animal hospital will be my first choice in the future. 😊❤️ …
